title: To improve
body: I seriously love the app. It has great potential and the idea in itself is amazing. But I BEG you please improve the user interface..it looks like a 2012 app..wish it was looking more minimalistic..man

title: Good looking app with CTD issues
body: This app looks good at the outset and has a clever method to track your habits/goals. Unfortunately it is crippled by crashing to the desktop so many times that it became essentially non-functional.
